understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked + simultaneously; completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces are selected and moved through the grid using directional actions or by clicking reachable positions. Walls and obstacles block movement, and movement may involve pushing pieces when permitted. Clicking changes the selected piece's position directly when the destination is reachable; blocked moves have no effect. Each action consumes a limited number of steps.
